useCase: Detecting AI generation 伪影 through noise residual 分析 using steg分析 techniques
mechanism: 应用 30 hand-crafted high-pass filters from the Spatial Rich Model to extract noise residuals at different scales and orientations. These residuals capture subtle 统计 regularities in the noise domain. A Truncated Linear Unit (TLU) activation constrains residual values, enhancing discrimination 之间 natural sensor noise and synthetic 噪声模式s.
accuracy: 高 - 83-91% for detecting synthetic 噪声模式s
name: SRM滤波分析
source: Fridrich & Kodovský (2012) - Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images, IEEE TIFS
algorithm: 30 SRM High-Pass Filters + Truncated Linear Unit
parameters: Filters: 30 SRM kernels (1st, 2nd, 3rd order), Truncation: T=3, 特征提取: co-occurrence matrices, Histogram bins: 2T+1=7 per dimension
description: 应用 Spatial Rich Model (SRM) high-pass filters to extract noise residuals. Originally developed for steg分析, these 30 hand-crafted filters effectively detect AI generation 伪影.

references.title: Fridrich, J. & Kodovský, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis of Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Zhou, P. et al. (2018). Learning Rich Features for Image Manipulation Detection. CVPR.

strengths:
• Captures diverse 噪声模式s with 30 specialized filters
• Originally proven effective in steg分析
• Multi-scale and multi-directional 分析
• Works well（高质量图像）
limitations:
• 计算密集 with 30 filter passes
• Heavy compression destroys subtle 噪声模式s
• Requires sufficient image 分辨率
• Performance varies 跨 different AI architectures
